title: Artist Invites Artists (AIA) – Summer 2027 and Fall 2027-Spring 2028 Wood Firing
how_to_join: Apply as a group through Artist Invites Artists portal (opens Feb 1, 2027)
summary: Group-based wood kiln firing (catenary arch or train) available summer 2027 and fall 2027–spring 2028. Artists apply together specifying kiln choice and firing schedule. No firings May 1–October 15 due to fire restrictions.
source_quote: Beginning in the fall of 2026, any artist who is interested in firing a wood kiln (either the catenary arch, or train kiln) will need to apply with a group of artists under the "Artist Invites Artists" or "AIA" application portal and should include which kiln they would like to fire, as well as a firing schedule within their application.
evidence_sentence: The residency page describes wood kiln firing through the Artist Invites Artists program, open to groups of artists applying with a specific firing schedule.
evidence_quote: INTERESTED IN FIRING A WOOD KILN AT RLCC? Beginning in the fall of 2026, any artist who is interested in firing a wood kiln (either the catenary arch, or train kiln) will need to apply with a group of artists
